data.spiritual_significance: Thomasine is a name rooted in faith, as it is derived from Thomas, one of the twelve apostles. In the New Testament, Thomas is known as Doubting Thomas because he doubted the resurrection of Jesus Christ until he saw and touched the wounds in Jesus' hands and side. This narrative encourages perseverance, as Thomas ultimately professed his belief in the resurrected Christ. The name Thomasine can serve as a reminder for individuals to keep faith in difficult times and steadfast in their convictions.
